about.title: About
about.appCardBody: An interactive A-Z alphabet learning app designed for kids. Each letter comes with colorful illustrations, fun words, and educational facts to make learning engaging and memorable!
about.featuresBody:
• Visual Learning: Beautiful illustrations for each letter
• Fun Facts: Interesting trivia about words and objects
• Word Examples: Multiple words starting with each letter
• Letter Types: Learn vowels and consonants
• Interactive: Tap, swipe, and explore at your own pace
about.benefitsBody:
✓ Builds vocabulary and reading skills
✓ Improves letter recognition
✓ Enhances visual memory
✓ Develops phonetic awareness
✓ Encourages independent learning
✓ Suitable for ages 3-7 years
about.offlineBody:
✓ Works completely offline
✓ No internet connection required
✓ All content cached locally
✓ Fast loading and smooth performance
✓ Available anywhere, anytime
about.howToUseBody:
1️⃣ Tap any letter on the home screen
2️⃣ Explore the colorful illustration
3️⃣ Read the word and description
4️⃣ Learn fun facts about each item
5️⃣ Use Next/Previous to browse letters
6️⃣ Enjoy random animations on every transition!
